FAQs - The Verge OKC Join the Newsletter About Who We Serve Ecosystem Spaces & Rentals News & Events Giving / Impact Getting Started FAQs Join the Newsletter Let’s see if your question has a quick answer: Is The Verge a coworking space? We have workspace, but we're a nonprofit entrepreneurship hub. Membership is about connections, mentors, and programming. All members and guests can enter the Citizen building via N. Robinson Ave. Meet us on the 5th floor to checkin, meet the community, and grow your business. What are the parking options? Paid street parking can be used with the Flowbird app. Other paid lots are located around the area. Valet service is available for $8. Those wishing to get monthly parking passes can work with The Verge staff for various options. Street Parking is free after 6 pm and on the weekends. Can The Verge fund my startup? We don't invest directly. We connect members to capital partners and programs when they're ready. Is The Verge right for me if I only have an idea? Our membership is built for founders who are already building. If you're earlier, we'll point you to the right starting resources and public events. How can I pay for my membership? The Verge uses OfficeRnD for both one-time and monthly payments. Non-members can visit our E-Commerce site . How can I support The Verge? Donate, mentor, sponsor an event, or partner with us. Learn more here
For private office/incubator membership, you get 4 hours/month for free.
